name: A.S.S. De Anti Survival Show
overview:
In this new reality show, 12 Dutch celebrities are dropped off on an island in Colombia. The goal? To secure a spot on a yacht located 150 meters from the island.

The participants must brave extreme heat, are denied access to a proper toilet, and there is hardly any food to be found on the island. Yet, there is a prospect of something better: a luxury yacht of about 42 meters is waiting for them within sight. Complete with all the necessary luxuries.

But swimming to it is forbidden. The contestants can only reach the yacht by playing a survival game. Although there is a way back: according to AD.nl, the Game of Deception, a kind of psychological game, determines who has to return to the beach.
